description: As a fourth-generation Idahoan raised on my family's farm, I understand the necessity of promoting the interests of Idaho families and preserving our way of life. Serving as YOUR VOICE IN CONGRESS is a responsibility I do not take lightly. I WILL NOT LET YOU DOWN! Join Russ Fulcher for Congress today and help us KEEP IDAHO RED!

title: RUSS FULCHER FOR CONGRESS
